title: LANGUAGE IMBALANCE DRIVEN REWARDING FOR MULTILINGUAL SELF-IMPROVING

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the disparity in model generation quality and instruction-following capabilities across dominant (e.g., English) and non-dominant languages using GPT-4 scoring and head-to-head win rates on parallel multilingual instructions.

Analyzing scoring inconsistencies when using LLM-as-a-judge (GPT-4) across different languages, which is evaluated and mitigated by conducting pairwise comparisons strictly within the same language to avoid cross-lingual scoring discrepancies.

Assessing and mitigating the exploitation of machine translation artifacts in multilingual benchmarks by using LLM self-translation to create training data that aligns more closely with native text distributions.
